newsitem.title: USA: Motorola gets $50 mln contract from China.
newsitem.headline: Motorola gets $50 mln contract from China.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Wednesday its Cellular Infrastructure Group received a $50 million contract to expand an existing analog cellular network in China's Jiangsu province.
The project will increase subscriber capacity to 500,000 from 400,000 by the end of 1997 and make the network China's third largest cellular system in terms of capacity, Motorola said.
The contract is with the Jiangsu Posts and Telecommunications Administration, Motorola said.
In May, Motorola said it had received a separate contract worth more than $50 million to expand the total access communications system cellular network in China's Shandong Province.
